sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release

system.description:
You focus superheated flame onto your striking implement of choice either your hand, feet, head or a weapon as they become smothered in flame.

You strike with this attacking implement, making a melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack, dealing damage based on the implement used;

Unarmed: [Unarmed Damage] + 5d6 fire damage.

Weapon: [Weapon Damage] + 4d8 fire damage.

On a hit, the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, being Immolated on a failure.

Scorch. By spending 3 Scorch Charges, you cause the strike to create a shockwave that fans out attempting to consume all in a 20-foot radius centered on the original target, excluding you. All creature in this radius, must make a Dexterity saving throw, being Dazed and gaining 1 rank of Burned on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and damage by 1d6 or 1d8 respectively.
